verses.1: We know that if our heavenly home is destroyed, then we will have a house from God, a house that will last forever in heaven.
verses.2: And indeed, in this, we delve deeper into the matter. We are about to invest our home, which belongs to heaven, with great effort.
verses.3: Perhaps, even when they are dressed, we will still find them naked.
verses.4: And indeed, those who are in the shelter become depressed and unwilling to be exposed to danger. They prefer to risk their lives rather than expose themselves to death.
verses.5: And this God, who works for our benefit, is the one who gives us the gift of marriage through the Spirit.
verses.6: Therefore, we are always distressed, and we know that we are being corrupted by the Lord within our bodies.
verses.7: For we travel out of faith, not out of sight.
verses.8: We also hope and desire to be released from this body and to be united with the Lord.
verses.9: Therefore, we will be honored, whether we are in charge or those who are in charge. It is desirable for them to be such.
verses.10: For we must all be revealed before the day of Christ comes, so that each person may receive what he has done through his body, whether it be good or evil.
verses.11: Since you know about the fear of that human ruler, let us be convinced of his power. But we hope that in your hearts, you will also be convinced of his true nature.
verses.12: We do not present ourselves to you again; instead, we give you an incentive for pride in our sake. This way, you will be proud of those who are outwardly proud, but not truly so in their hearts.
verses.13: For whether we are freed from sin, oh God! Or whether we act with wisdom, for you.
verses.14: For the love of Christ continues to sustain us, even though we know that He died for all people. Therefore, all people will also die.
verses.15: And for all these reasons, he died, so that those who are alive might no longer live for themselves alone, but also die and be raised together with him.
verses.16: So from now on, we will know nothing about the body at all. Even if we once knew something about the body through Christ, now we no longer do.
verses.17: So, if anyone is in Christ, it’s a new creation. The old things have passed away; now, something new has come into being.
verses.18: And all these things were arranged by the God who created us for His own purposes, through Christ. He also gave us the duty of fulfilling this arrangement.
verses.19: For in Christ, God reconciled the world to himself, not considering their sins, and he placed the word of reconciliation among us.
verses.20: Therefore, we pray as representatives of Christ, asking for his help through us. We will serve Christ, so that we may be pleasing to God.
verses.21: He committed a sin that we couldn’t recognize as such, so that we might become righteous in God’s eyes.
